Company description: PFE (Generated via gemini-3.1-flash-lite)

Pfizer Inc. (PFE) is a leading global research-based biopharmaceutical company dedicated to discovering, developing, and manufacturing innovative medicines and vaccines. Headquartered in New York City, the company operates across a broad spectrum of therapeutic areas, including oncology, internal medicine, immunology, and infectious diseases. Pfizer is widely recognized for its significant contributions to global health, most notably its role in developing the first FDA-authorized COVID-19 vaccine in collaboration with BioNTech.

Founded in 1849 by cousins Charles Pfizer and Charles Erhart as a chemical business in Brooklyn, the company initially focused on producing fine chemicals and antiparasitic treatments. Over the subsequent 175 years, Pfizer evolved into a pharmaceutical powerhouse through internal research and strategic acquisitions, such as the landmark mergers with Warner-Lambert, Pharmacia, and Wyeth. Today, Pfizer remains committed to leveraging scientific breakthroughs and advanced manufacturing capabilities to address some of the world’s most challenging health conditions, maintaining a robust pipeline that emphasizes both preventative care and complex therapeutic interventions.
